closed_finding.issue: Evaluating errorChain inside the same dictionary literal delayed retention of actual returned/native_error until the new traversal completed; a traversal exception could lose those existing observations.
closed_finding.correction: Final lines143-144 retain the original returned/native_error dictionary first, then assign error_chain separately. The outer exception handler can therefore preserve those fields if traversal throws.

source_findings: Delta is confined to the new errorChain helper, native record schema1-to2 and operation.error_chain assignment. Existing single public setter, paths, ownership/context/image checks, sampling, alarm and nonqualification flags are unchanged.

Traversal follows only NSError.userInfo[NSUnderlyingErrorKey], emits at most four errorRecord nodes and retains at most four NSError objects. Pointer-identity cycle detection avoids recursive equality and ARC strong array ownership keeps compared objects alive.

Nested objects are checked as NSError before traversal. Terminal states are closed: no-error, no-underlying, non-error, cycle, depth-limit. A fourth node examines only the next relation to distinguish actual termination from truncation; no fifth node is serialized.

Nodes contain only Boolean present, integer code and closed none/cocoa/posix/other domain labels. No descriptions, userInfo dump, arbitrary domain strings, paths, pointer values, retries, debugger or extra filesystem/protection operation is added.

Objective-C generics, ARC references, dictionary subscripting and the public NSUnderlyingErrorKey use show no source-level compile/type/lifetime defect in this bounded inspection. Native compilation is not claimed.
limits: Driver schema2/chain validation, source/control admission, tests and native execution require their separate reviews. This approval does not attest those activities.

Node-count bounds do not guarantee individual Foundation accessors cannot block; existing self-only alarm and owned driver timeout remain required. A process-level timeout may still prevent final serialization.

H02 at22ea retains only its actual outer Cocoa256 error. New underlying-error observations have not run, cannot be inferred retrospectively and cannot alone promote original strict protection or product qualification.
activity: Read-only delta review and final-pin verification; no project imports, tests, builds, network, dispatches or native source edits. This approval receipt is the only file authored for this source review.
